CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content organization is asserted.

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinate set), its organization/access metadata (origin), and a separate status distinction are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No attention/allocation or processing-condition linked to the same content's presentation/access is asserted.

C.rationale: Explicit content identificaton: named referent with an attribute and coordinate value.

D.rationale: The report separately lists the content (red coordinates) and its origin/status metadata for the same referent, distinguishing identity from organization/access.

O.rationale: A presentation/access/organization description (origin and represented_time) is explicitly associated with the identified referent.
